name: Portovenere, Cinque Terre, and the Islands (Palmaria, Tino and Tinetto)
description: Along Italy's Ligurian coast, five pastel fishing villages (Monterosso, Vernazza, Corniglia, Manarola and Riomaggiore) cling to cliffs above the sea, with Portovenere and its offshore islands at the southern end. Generations of farmers carved terraces into the steep hillsides, and walking paths, trains and boats link the villages, since cars struggle to reach them.
